map.奶牛通常 12~13 个月（365~395 天）为宜。: Dairy cows are usually culled at 12-13 months (365-395 days).
map.每延长 1 天约损失 0.07 kg/天，长间隔显著降年单产。: Each extra day costs about 0.07 kg/day, and a long interval noticeably lowers annual yield per cow.

map.评估繁殖效率与奶量损失。: Assess breeding efficiency and milk loss.
map.输入产犊日期、配种与空怀记录，评估奶牛或肉牛的产犊间隔、空怀天数和繁殖效率指标，: Enter calving dates, breeding and open (non-pregnant) records to evaluate the calving interval, open days and breeding efficiency indices of dairy or beef cattle, giving a quantitative basis for optimising breeding herd management.
map.配种次数反推受胎率。: Back out the conception rate from the number of breedings.
map.：妊娠 283 天 → 空怀 107 天；配种 2 次 → 受胎率 50%；比理: : gestation 283 days -> open 107 days; 2 breedings -> conception rate 50%; that is 25 days more than the ideal 365, so the daily milk loss is 25*0.07=1.75 kg/day.
map.：间隔 365 天、1 次受胎 → 空怀 82 天、受胎率 100%，无额外奶损: : interval 365 days and conception on the first breeding -> open 82 days, conception rate 100%, with no extra milk loss.
